pe_ratio_interpretation: A P/E ratio below 15 may indicate undervaluation, while above 25 may indicate overvaluation. Compare within the same industry.
yield_vs_coupon: Coupon rate is fixed at issuance based on face value. Current yield fluctuates with market price. When price falls below face value, current yield rises above coupon rate.
bond_pricing: Bonds trade at premium when price > face value (yield < coupon). Bonds trade at discount when price < face value (yield > coupon).
